label: Area Model Multiplication

defects.what: Partial-product boxes are equal width whatever the place value (100 and 9 same size); every item is 1-digit x 2/3-digit with no 2-digit x 2-digit edge case.
defects.fix: Keep open model but vary one item type (e.g. one 2x2-digit) or scale column widths lightly.

defects.what: Rounded answer boxes sit inside square model cells, a doubled border in every part.
defects.fix: Use the model cell itself as the slot or drop the inner box border to the grey.

defects.what: Step 1 says 'Split each number into tens and ones' but the split is pre-printed and item 1 has a hundreds part (100 30 5).
defects.fix: Reword: 'Read the parts: hundreds, tens, ones.' or make the split the pupil's step.

defects.what: Guided cells carry no item labels (a., b.) while every other role does.
Same single item type throughout; no 2-digit x 2-digit item.
Only 2 items; the lower ~45% of each cell is empty band below the model.
defects.fix: Fit 3-4 items per page or shrink cell height to content.

defects.what: Page titled 'I Can multiply with an area model' gives an empty work box with no area-model frame; key shows only '5 x 147 = 735', so the named method never appears.
defects.fix: Pre-draw an empty area-model frame in the work space and show the filled model in the key.

defects.what: Screen slots are square-cornered while the paper slots are rounded.
Square-cornered slots differ from paper.
Model fills the width with small side margins; digits ~34px, below 40px phone target for the stem line.
3-part models break: column labels wrap ('100 80' then '5' on a second line), the multiplier '3'/'6' is pushed above the model instead of to its left, so labels no longer sit over their columns.
defects.fix: Give 3-part models a min cell width or scale the model to the card; never wrap the label row.

defects.what: Cards of one skill differ in height (items 2, 4 taller) and layout.
Model geometry differs from the paper drawing.
defects.fix: Render with the same kit template and metrics as print.

defects.what: Model is off-centre: ~75px left margin, the '8' column touches the right cell border.
defects.fix: Centre the model and keep equal margins.

summary: Fix the online-worksheet 3-part model wrap (labels and multiplier detached from columns), put an area-model frame on word problems, and fill the error-analysis page.

label: Arrays & Equal Groups (Visual)

defects.what: Slot set changes item to item (3 slots, 1 slot, 3 slots); in a. the total box sits higher than the other two and the sentence lacks its full stop.
defects.fix: One sentence frame per section: '__ rows of __ = __' on every item, slots on one baseline.

defects.what: 'How many dots in all?' is pure counting; no groups/rows or multiplication link, while the title says 'to multiply'.
defects.fix: Always ask rows/groups, size and total, and add an 'x' equation frame.

defects.what: 3 items per page; lower ~45% of each cell is empty.
defects.fix: Shrink cells or fit 4-6 items (two columns).

defects.what: Mixed routine within one section breaks AX-4.
defects.fix: Split into sections by item type.

defects.what: Two items only; ~60% of the page below them is empty.
defects.fix: Fit 4-6 guided items or a two-row grid.

defects.what: Worked example gives the whole answer (10) with only a total slot, and item 2 pre-fills '5'; pupil practises 1.5 items.
defects.fix: Model item plus 3-4 practice items with a fading hint.

defects.what: Instruction asks for groups, number in each and total but item 1 has only a total slot.
Different slot sets per item; a. total box raised.
Count-all item on a multiplication test.
Lower ~45% of each cell empty.
Correct/Fix-it boxes sit under the model in a. but to the right in b.
defects.fix: One position for the check column in every cell.

defects.what: Large empty bands in both cells (bottom ~40%).
Sentence frame sits above the array on screen but below it on paper; a stray '.' floats between the second and third slot.
defects.fix: Same order as paper; remove the lone period.

defects.what: 'Solve.' gives no cue about rows vs total.
Violet double border around the cell.
Frame above picture, stray '.', differs from paper.
'Solve.'
'How many dots in all?' — counting, not multiplication.
Cards of mixed types and heights; frames wrap onto two lines with slots split across lines.
defects.fix: One item type per section, uniform height.

defects.what: Stray '.' between slots; frame wraps so 'in all' starts a new line.
defects.fix: Keep frame on one line or stack it deliberately.

defects.what: Count-all items.
Frame above picture with stray '.'.
'Solve.' instruction.

summary: Use one rows/groups-of/total frame for every item (drop count-all items), fill the pages (guided is 60% empty), and match screen order to paper.

label: Multiplication Facts (1-12)

defects.what: No x1/x0 edge-case beyond h. and no commutative pair; fine but plain.
No item labels on guided cells.
Only one worked example; no hint fade across the page.
defects.fix: Fade a skip-count cue across the first row.

defects.what: 4x3 cells ~75 mm tall for one-line facts; bottom two-thirds of each cell empty.
defects.fix: Use 4x4 or 5x4 like fact rows, or shorter cells.

defects.what: Some empty band under each stack.
4-column grid identical to the independent page; the standard's fact-row layout is 5-10 columns (mock-up 02).
defects.fix: Use the 5-column fact layout with a number strip.

defects.what: ~12% empty band between the grid and the footer.
Both stories use the same context and frame ('rows of chairs'); only 2 items.
defects.fix: Vary contexts (groups, arrays, equal sharing wording).

defects.what: Digits ~50px, just under the 56px desktop target.
The x sign touches the second factor ('x10', 'x11'): operator not in its own track.
Stacks sit at different horizontal positions from card to card.
defects.fix: Centre the stack in every cell.

summary: Give fact-rows the real 5-10 column layout, tighten the test cells, fix the worksheet operator track, and vary the word-problem contexts.

label: Multiplication Chart (Visual)

defects.what: Answer slots are ~10 mm boxes inside chart cells, below the 14 mm writing room for 2-digit products.
defects.fix: Enlarge chart cells (fewer columns) so each slot is ≥14 mm.

defects.what: Charts fill the top ~55% of each cell; bottom ~40% empty.
defects.fix: Scale charts to the cell or use 1 column x 3 rows larger charts.

defects.what: 3-digit products (108, 100) do not fit the slot: in the key they overflow the box border.
defects.fix: Size slots for the largest product or cap factors.

defects.what: Fade is inconsistent: item 2 pre-fills one of three blanks.
defects.fix: Model item fully, practice items empty.

defects.what: Key digits overrun the slot outline.
~10 mm slots.
Bottom ~40% of each cell empty.
Only 11 is wrong (6x5=30) but the key writes '30, 35, 48' in the single 'correct answer' box — the key does not match the slot or the task.
defects.fix: Key the one fixed product; name which cell was wrong.

defects.what: The 'correct answer' box cannot hold three numbers.
defects.fix: One box per circled cell, or ask for the one wrong product.

defects.what: Large empty bands below each chart.
Slots ~46px, at the 44px floor.
Chart digits ~18px, well below the 29px worksheet target.
defects.fix: Fewer columns per card or bigger cards.

defects.what: Input boxes butt against chart cell borders (doubled, misaligned lines).
defects.fix: Inset the input inside the cell.

summary: Fix the error-analysis key (one fixed product, not a list), and make chart answer slots big enough to write (≥14 mm, 3-digit safe) while filling the cells.

label: Basic Subtraction

defects.what: No 0 or n−n edge case.
No item labels on guided cells.
4x3 cells ~75 mm tall; bottom two-thirds of each cell empty.
4-column grid, same as independent; fact rows should be the 5-10 column layout.
~12% empty band above the footer.
Two items; work space large for Grade 1.
Minus touches '10' ('-10'): operator not in its own track.
Stack position varies card to card.

summary: Real 5-10 column fact-rows, shorter test cells, and an operator track on the online worksheet.

label: Subtract Within 5 with Pictures (Visual)

defects.what: Cross-out strokes extend past each shape into its neighbour; crossed stars (c) are hard to read as stars.
defects.fix: Shorter X inside the shape bounds.

defects.what: No item labels.
Five crossed stars merge into one scribble.
A 'with pictures' K skill prints stories with no pictures; key work shows only '3 − 2 = 1'.
defects.fix: Add the picture row (with cross-outs to draw) in the work space.

defects.what: Three sentences plus a written label is a heavy reading/writing load for Kindergarten.
defects.fix: Shorter story, picture support, label from a bank.

defects.what: The answer input's bottom edge is clipped by the cell border.
defects.fix: Add bottom padding / let the cell grow.

defects.what: Answer input clipped at the cell bottom.
Answer input clipped at the cell bottom.
Pictures ~20px; crossed stars become an unreadable scribble.
defects.fix: Picture size ≥ card digits; simpler shapes for crossed items.

defects.what: Two-line prompt above every card duplicates the equation.

summary: Stop clipping the answer box on the practice card, and give word problems the picture row this K skill is named for.
